column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for the corporate website (CW-QA-009).
# Every passive-scan warning fails CI unless it is listed here with a reason.

column3: Non-Storable Content: pages are deliberately "private, no-store" so the host's LiteSpeed cache cannot serve an old release (frontend/app/layout.tsx, RUNBOOKS RB-3).
Modern Web Application: informational; the site is a Next.js app (the spider still covers every page; E2E covers client behaviour).

Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens: the contact form sends JSON with fetch to the API, which uses no cookies or sessions and accepts only the website origin (CORS); there is no authenticated state to forge. Without JavaScript the form posts to the page itself, which ignores it.
